svg.title: One decode step across tensor-parallel ranks
svg.desc: In each decode step every rank processes the same verification rows: for each running sequence, its newest token and three draft tokens. In every decoder layer each rank computes a partial attention output and a partial mixture-of-experts output from the weights it holds, and an all-reduce on RoCEnante sums them; hyper-connection mixing runs on every rank. The LM head is split by vocabulary and its logits are all-gathered. Rejection sampling keeps the accepted drafts and adds one target token, and the one-layer MTP head drafts three tokens for the next step. Decode-size collectives use RoCEnante; larger ones, mostly prefill, use NCCL 2.32.3. On four Sparks, traffic between opposite Sparks is forwarded in hardware by the Spark between them.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
